entities.name: Sythis
entities.description: Nyxborn nymph of Theros, Harvest's Hand, created by Karametra to guard the harvest and grown into her trusted advisor and companion.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: God of Theros who created Sythis and grants her a greater share of divine power than other servants.

events.summary: Karametra brought Sythis into being to guard the harvest and oversee threshing.
events.quote: Sythis was brought into being by the god Karametra to guard the harvest

events.summary: Sythis evolved into Karametra's trusted advisor and close companion.
events.quote: Sythis evolved into a trusted advisor and close companion to the goddess herself.

relations.quote: Sythis was brought into being by the god Karametra
Karametra's most potent representative on Theros
